The '''400-year jubilee''' of the Unification falls in the year 400 A.U. — four years after the series begins.

The powers of [[the Banner-lands]] are preparing a grand celebration: a realm-wide retelling of the [[Chronicle of Victory]], led by [[House Blackcrest]], whose heralds travel the realm gathering testimony. It will be the greatest telling of the founding story in living memory — at the very moment the founding story's oldest questions refuse to stay closed.

The celebration and the truth are on a collision course: a quiet clock ticking through the early books.
